entities.summary: Otto Bache was a Danish Realist painter best known for his depictions of historical scenes, animal studies, genre compositions, and portraits. His work played an important role in Danish nineteenth-century art, and he remained closely connected with the Royal Danish Academy of Fine Arts throughout his life.
